---
name: Correct evidence or attribution / 证据与归属纠错
about: Report a wrong quote, speaker, date, interpretation or changed source / 纠正错引、过度推论和来源变化
title: "[Evidence] "
---

## Affected records / 相关条目

Person, source/evidence/principle IDs, or a repository file link:
人物、来源／证据／原则 ID，或仓库文件链接：

## Problem and supporting source / 问题与依据

Explain the mismatch and link the original passage, page or timestamp. Distinguish uncertain, contradicted and unavailable material.
说明哪里不一致，附原始段落、页码或时间戳；区分尚不确定、已有反证和暂时无法读取。

## Suggested correction and scope / 建议修正与范围

Should a quote, speaker, date, interpretation, review status or application limit change? Preserve relevant historical context.
需要改动原话、说话人、日期、归纳、核验状态还是适用边界？保留必要的历史语境。

## Reproduction, if relevant / 如涉及检索，如何复现

Add a minimal query and expected behavior. Use fictional example circumstances instead of private user information.
附最小提问与预期结果，使用虚构情境，不粘贴私人聊天或敏感信息。
